Today we are announcing the release date for LoveKami -Divinity Stage-!
December 16, 2016!

notes.title: Great news! Giveaway campaign update
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

We've seen the response on Thunderclap and we are ecstatic to announce that just two days into the campaign, the number of supporters have exceeded 1,000! To celebrate this occasion, and to increase the chance supporters will receive, we have decided to increase the number of Steam keys we will give away!

Double the original amount we were previously going to give out, supporters, you'll be glad to know that the number of steam keys to be won has increased from 20 to a whopping 40!!!! Double! Isn't that awesome? 

Remember, all you have to do is:

1. SUPPORT our Thunderclap campaign here: https://www.thunderclap.it/projects/19332-official-steam-release?locale=en

2. SHARE and our Facebook post below!
https://www.facebook.com/Moenovel/photos/a.374680502650894.1073741831.371028273016117/655315967920678/?type=1&theater

Easy isn't it? Come join in the fun! Support and share right now to help spread the word!

*Campaign runs till 24th November 2014 12:00 (PST)
